content.title: Can’t Find the Hafezi, Noorani, or Madani Quran Mushaf in the Muslims Day App?
content.subtitle: Choose your preferred Mushaf print right now.
content.body:
When reciting the Quran on digital screens, many of us feel a sense of dissatisfaction. The pages of the Hafezi Quran we read and memorized from since childhood, or the Noorani Kolkata print, or the fonts of the Madani Mushaf that our eyes have grown accustomed to—it becomes difficult to find that traditional spiritual ambiance in the standard fonts of a smartphone. Without that familiar border, specific line layout, and recognized script before our eyes, it feels as though full concentration in recitation is difficult to attain.

Respected user, did you know? To honor this cherished habit and sentiment of yours, a unique solution has been introduced to the Muslims Day app—an exact digital archive of real printed Quran pages.

1. Recitation in Your Familiar and Preferred Print

Every reciter has their own reading comfort. For Huffaz, matching pages without a 15-line Hafezi Quran is challenging, while for general readers across the Indian subcontinent, the Noorani Kolkata print or the Naskh (Indo-Pak) script is the easiest to read. On the other hand, the Madani Mushaf holds unique acceptance throughout the Arab world and internationally. Keeping these preferences in mind, our ‘Select Mushaf’ list includes—Naskh (Indo-Pak), Hafezi (15 lines), Noorani (Kolkata Print), Shemerly Mushaf, Qira'at Warsh, Qalun Mushaf, Color-Coded Tajweed Mushaf, and multiple editions of the Madani Mushaf. As a result, the exact script you are accustomed to is now right at your fingertips.

2. Download Once, Enjoy Lifetime Offline Reading

It is not always possible to have an internet connection to read the Quran—especially during long journeys, in out-of-network areas, or while quietly engaged in worship at the mosque. Keeping that in mind, each Mushaf can be downloaded once. Once downloaded, you can smoothly recite and turn pages just like a physical book completely offline, without needing mobile data or Wi-Fi. Additionally, there is the full flexibility to choose High Quality or Low Quality based on your phone’s storage.

3. How to Easily Select and Download a Mushaf

  • Open the Muslims Day app and go to the ‘Quran’ section from the bottom navigation bar.

  • Tap the Settings (gear icon) in the top-right corner.

  • Scroll down to the ‘Reading Settings’ section and select the ‘Select Mushaf’ option.

  • From the list of various printed editions, choose the Mushaf you are accustomed to and complete the download.

4. How to Directly Start Reciting After Download

Once the Mushaf is downloaded, you no longer need to go into any settings:

  • Return to the main Quran page in the app.

  • Tap the ‘Recite’ (তিলাওয়াত) button in the top-left corner.

  • Your downloaded original printed Mushaf will instantly open in full screen.

May your daily recitation become more vibrant and blessed through this union of technological convenience and timeless tradition. Set up your preferred Mushaf today and immerse yourself directly in the radiant realm of the words of Allah.
